en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the AV room.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Watch an action movie
Watch a comedy movie
Watch an anime movie
Is that your request?

A maid should not show their emotions
during work...

But...I am happy. 
Action is my favorite movie genre.

Such refreshing movies with dramatic
stories relieve my daily fatigue.
Is that your request?

While I do not have a problem watching
a comedic movie...

If you wish to watch a movie with a woman,
please choose more wisely in the future.

If you do not have similar humor to your
partner, then it becomes quite unpleasant.
This might be nettlesome for you to hear...

But I am quite reluctant to let you spend
your time like this with a woman.

Please understand that it is also a maid's
duty to scold her client.
So is this truly your request?
If so, then I understand...

<CLT=cltMIND>Judging from that response...
perhaps she doesn't like anime?

<CLT=cltMIND>I wish she would just say "no"...
But I understand. Kirumi is obedient to a fault.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Kirumi looks deep in thought...
(How should I...?)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kirumi's inner thoughts...?
